natural: the guest follows the host's convenience

meaning.en: A guest should go along with the host's arrangements.
meaning.zh: 客人应该顺从主人的安排。

equivalents: a guest should follow the host's lead

examples.zh: 您安排吧，客随主便。
examples.en: You decide; the guest follows the host.

examples.zh: 去哪家餐厅都行，客随主便嘛。
examples.en: Any restaurant will do; the guest follows the host.

examples.zh: 到了人家家里，客随主便，别太挑剔。
examples.en: When you're at someone's house, follow the host's arrangements and don't be fussy.

usage.en: Polite, often said by guests when accepting plans. Note the difference from 入乡随俗 (follow local customs) and the saying 主随客便 (host follows guest).
usage.zh: 客气话，客人常用来表示听从安排。注意与“入乡随俗”（遵守当地习俗）及“主随客便”（主人听从客人）不同。

meaning.en: To attract the attention of the opposite sex, often by being flirtatious; sometimes it means attracting unwanted attention.
meaning.zh: 比喻引诱异性，也指行为招摇、惹来是非。

examples.zh: 她穿着很招摇，被人说成招蜂引蝶。
examples.en: She dressed flashily and was said to be flirting.

examples.zh: 他爱招蜂引蝶，女朋友很不放心。
examples.en: He likes to attract women and his girlfriend isn't at ease.

examples.zh: 别在外面招蜂引蝶，惹出麻烦。
examples.en: Don't go flirting around and causing trouble.

usage.en: Derogatory, mainly about people (often women in older usage, but also men now). Often in gossip. Original sense: flowers attract bees and butterflies.
usage.zh: 贬义，多用于人，常在议论中出现。本义是花香引来蜂蝶。

meaning.en: A poetic picture of spring in southern China, soft rain and blossoms; a gentle, romantic mood.
meaning.zh: 杏花盛开、春雨绵绵的江南春景，形容温柔浪漫的情调。

equivalents: the soft beauty of the Jiangnan spring

examples.zh: 杏花春雨，江南的春天温润如诗。
examples.en: Apricot blossoms and spring rain: the Jiangnan spring is gentle as poetry.

examples.zh: 这首词写尽了杏花春雨的江南意境。
examples.en: This ci poem captures the mood of Jiangnan in spring blossoms and rain.

examples.zh: 三月去苏州，正逢杏花春雨，景色宜人。
examples.en: If you go to Suzhou in March, you'll catch the spring rain and blossoms.

usage.en: Poetic; often with 骏马秋风 ('swift steed in autumn wind') as the contrast of northern and southern scenery. Often seen in titles.
usage.zh: 诗意用语，常与“骏马秋风”对举，一南一北。

meaning.en: To remember something after a single reading; an excellent memory.
meaning.zh: 看一遍就能背诵，形容记忆力极强。

examples.zh: 他天资聪颖，过目成诵。
examples.en: He is gifted and can recite after one reading.

examples.zh: 这位老教授记性极好，过目成诵。
examples.en: The old professor has an excellent memory and can recite after one glance.

examples.zh: 别以为学霸都过目成诵，他们也是苦读出来的。
examples.en: Don't think top students all have photographic memories; they study hard.

usage.en: Compliment for intelligence; 过目不忘 stresses not forgetting, 过目成诵 stresses being able to recite. Predicate.
usage.zh: 褒义，称赞记忆力。与“过目不忘”相比，更强调能背诵。

meaning.en: The sadness and tangled feelings that come with saying goodbye.
meaning.zh: 离别时愁苦、不舍的情绪。

examples.zh: 站台上，大家都带着离情别绪。
examples.en: On the platform, everyone was in a mood of parting.

examples.zh: 这首诗写出了诗人的离情别绪。
examples.en: This poem expresses the poet's feelings of parting.

examples.zh: 毕业季，校园里弥漫着离情别绪。
examples.en: At graduation, the campus was full of farewell feelings.

usage.en: A literary phrase for goodbye feelings, common in classical poems and graduation writing. Subject or object of verbs like 抒发、表达、弥漫.
usage.zh: 书面语，常与“抒发、表达、弥漫”搭配。

meaning.en: To be blocked and make no headway; stuck in one place.
meaning.zh: 因受阻而不能前进，没有进展。

examples.zh: 谈判停滞不前，双方都不肯让步。
examples.en: The talks have stalled and neither side will compromise.

examples.zh: 满足现状只会让人停滞不前。
examples.en: Being content with the status quo only makes people stagnate.

examples.zh: 近年经济增长停滞不前。
examples.en: Economic growth has stagnated in recent years.

usage.en: Common in news and school essays. Predicate or modifier (…，停滞不前的局面).
usage.zh: 新闻和作文中常用，可作谓语或定语。

meaning.en: In the writing itself, including what it implies between the lines.
meaning.zh: 文章的文字和行与行之间，指文中所流露的含意。

equivalents: in the text and between the lines

examples.zh: 字里行间透露出作者的无奈。
examples.en: Between the lines the author's helplessness is evident.

examples.zh: 从字里行间可以看出她对故乡的思念。
examples.en: From between the lines you can see her longing for home.

examples.zh: 读书要读出字里行间的意思。
examples.en: In reading you should pick up the meaning between the lines.

usage.en: Note 行 is read háng ('line') here. Often followed by verbs like 流露、透露、读出.
usage.zh: “行”读háng。常与“流露、透露、读出”搭配。

natural: clear the mind and see one's nature

meaning.en: In Chan Buddhism, to understand the mind and see one's original nature directly.
meaning.zh: 佛教禅宗指摒除杂念，领悟本心，见到自己的本性。

equivalents: clear the mind and perceive its nature

examples.zh: 禅修的目的是明心见性。
examples.en: The goal of Chan meditation is to see one's true nature.

examples.zh: 她读经多年，终于有了明心见性的感悟。
examples.en: After years of reading the sutras she gained insight into her own mind.

examples.zh: 山中静居三月，他说颇有明心见性之感。
examples.en: After three months of quiet in the mountains, he said he felt he had come to see his own mind.

usage.en: Religious and philosophical term from Chan Buddhism, often in 直指人心，见性成佛. Now sometimes used broadly for 'self-realisation'.
usage.zh: 禅宗术语，常与“直指人心，见性成佛”连用，今也泛指自我觉悟。

natural: a lady in red sleeves adds incense

meaning.en: A romantic picture of a scholar studying at night with a beautiful girl beside him adding incense.
meaning.zh: 指读书人夜读时有佳人在旁伴读添香，形容文人的风雅与艳福。

equivalents: a scholar with a beautiful companion at his side

examples.zh: 他梦想着红袖添香夜读书的生活。
examples.en: He dreams of the life of reading at night with a lovely companion beside him.

examples.zh: 古装剧里常有红袖添香的雅致场景。
examples.en: Period dramas often have the elegant scene of a lady adding incense for a scholar.

examples.zh: 书房里没有红袖添香，只有一杯清茶。
examples.en: In the study there was no beautiful companion, only a cup of tea.

usage.en: Literary; evokes the traditional literati fantasy. Today used lightly or ironically. 袖 xiù, 'sleeves', represents women.
usage.zh: 书面语，带有旧时文人的理想色彩，今多半带调侃。“红袖”借指女子。

meaning.en: Gentle music and graceful dancing; a festive, leisurely entertainment.
meaning.zh: 轻柔的歌声、舒缓的舞姿，形容欢乐悠闲的歌舞场面。

examples.zh: 晚会上轻歌曼舞，气氛欢快。
examples.en: At the evening gala there was soft singing and graceful dancing, and a cheerful mood.

examples.zh: 景区里每晚都有轻歌曼舞的表演。
examples.en: The scenic area has soft singing and dancing every night.

examples.zh: 江南的轻歌曼舞，令游客流连忘返。
examples.en: The graceful song and dance of Jiangnan make tourists linger.

usage.en: Mostly neutral to positive. Occasionally has a hint of 'decadent' in historical contexts (e.g. of court life). Often with 莺歌燕舞.
usage.zh: 多为褒义或中性；写旧时宫廷生活时有时略含“奢靡”意味。常与“莺歌燕舞”近。

natural: surging and about to burst forth

meaning.en: Describes the sun rising with great force and brilliance; also something about to burst out.
meaning.zh: 形容太阳初升时光芒四射、力量强劲的样子，也比喻事物将要强劲涌现。

equivalents: the sun rising in a blaze

examples.zh: 东方的红日喷薄欲出，海面一片金光。
examples.en: The red sun in the east was about to burst forth, and the sea glittered gold.

examples.zh: 泰山日出，喷薄欲出，令人振奋。
examples.en: The sunrise over Mount Tai bursts forth and is inspiring.

examples.zh: 新生力量喷薄欲出，行业正在洗牌。
examples.en: New forces are on the verge of bursting out and the industry is being reshuffled.

usage.en: A set description for sunrise in essays (薄 here is read bó, in the sense of 'surge', not báo). Common in exam essays.
usage.zh: 描写日出的固定说法，常用于作文。“薄”读bó，有“迫近、涌动”义。

meaning.en: Having a dignified, impressive and handsome look.
meaning.zh: 相貌端正，气度不凡。

examples.zh: 这位将军相貌堂堂，气宇轩昂。
examples.en: The general is handsome and imposing, with a lofty bearing.

examples.zh: 他看上去相貌堂堂，没想到是个骗子。
examples.en: He looked dignified and handsome, but turned out to be a fraud.

examples.zh: 小伙子相貌堂堂，一表人才。
examples.en: The young man is handsome and imposing, an impressive person.

usage.en: Praise for men's looks; sometimes used ironically for people whose appearance does not match their character. 相 is read xiàng here (appearance), not xiāng.
usage.zh: 多用于夸男子外貌端正；有时反讽“人不可貌相”。“相”读xiàng。

meaning.en: In Buddhism, to rescue all beings from suffering and bring them to enlightenment.
meaning.zh: 佛教指广泛救度一切众生，使他们脱离苦海。

examples.zh: 佛教强调慈悲，普度众生。
examples.en: Buddhism stresses compassion and the salvation of all beings.

examples.zh: 他立志行医，普度众生。
examples.en: He resolved to practise medicine and relieve all beings' suffering.

examples.zh: 菩萨发愿普度众生。
examples.en: The bodhisattva vowed to save all beings.

usage.en: Religious; also used in a general, slightly grand sense for 'rescuing the world'. Pronounced pǔ dù (度 'cross over', not 'degree').
usage.zh: 宗教用语，也泛指救世济人。“度”读dù，意为“渡、救度”。

meaning.en: The two sides are sharply divided with clear boundaries and no confusion.
meaning.zh: 对立双方界限分明，立场鲜明。

examples.zh: 两派壁垒分明，谁也不肯让步。
examples.en: The two factions are sharply divided and neither will yield.

examples.zh: 辩论赛上，正反方壁垒分明。
examples.en: In the debate the two sides were clearly demarcated.

examples.zh: 公司内部壁垒分明，沟通成本很高。
examples.en: Internal divisions in the company are sharp and communication is costly.

usage.en: From military camps (壁垒 = fortifications). Neutral; can be positive (clear stance) or negative (rigid divide). 垒 is lěi.
usage.zh: 源于军营的“壁垒”。中性，可指立场分明，也可指界限森严。“垒”读lěi。

literal: household · thief · hard · to guard against
natural: the thief within the house is hard to guard against

meaning.en: An insider who betrays you is much harder to guard against than an outsider.
meaning.zh: 内部人员作案或出卖，比外人更难提防。

equivalents: the enemy within is hardest to guard against

examples.zh: 商业机密泄露，真是家贼难防。
examples.en: The business secrets leaked: truly, the thief within is hard to guard against.

examples.zh: 古话说家贼难防，用人要谨慎。
examples.en: As the old saying goes, the thief inside is hard to guard against, so be careful in hiring.

examples.zh: 公司被内鬼坑了一把，这就叫家贼难防。
examples.en: The company was cheated by an insider; that's what 'the thief at home' means.

usage.en: Proverbial, casual; often said after a leak or an inside job. Often 家贼难防，明枪易躲，暗箭难防 pattern.
usage.zh: 谚语，口语，常在发生内部泄密、内鬼作案之后说。

meaning.en: Parents are loving and their children dutiful: the ideal of family harmony.
meaning.zh: 父母慈爱，子女孝顺，家庭和睦。

examples.zh: 春节团圆饭上，一家人父慈子孝，其乐融融。
examples.en: At the Spring Festival reunion dinner the family was loving and dutiful, and happy together.

examples.zh: 他们家一直是父慈子孝的典范。
examples.en: Their family has long been a model of loving parents and filial children.

examples.zh: 儒家认为父慈子孝是家庭伦理的基础。
examples.en: Confucians hold that kind fathers and filial sons are the foundation of family ethics.

story.en: The Liyun chapter lists ten human duties: 'the kindness of fathers and filial piety of sons, the goodness of elder brothers and respect of younger ones...' (父慈、子孝、兄良、弟弟、夫义、妇听、长惠、幼顺、君仁、臣忠).
story.zh: 《礼记·礼运》：“何谓人义？父慈、子孝、兄良、弟弟、夫义、妇听、长惠、幼顺、君仁、臣忠，十者谓之人义。”

usage.en: A formal blessing and ideal; usually paired with 兄友弟恭 (elder brother friendly, younger respectful).
usage.zh: 正式的理想和祝愿，常与“兄友弟恭”连用。

meaning.en: The high and mighty of society: those with power and rank.
meaning.zh: 泛指有权势、地位的人。

examples.zh: 王侯将相宁有种乎？
examples.en: Are kings, marquises, generals and ministers born that way?

examples.zh: 在历史长河中，王侯将相也都化作尘土。
examples.en: In the river of history even the powerful turn to dust.

examples.zh: 她出身平民，却和王侯将相平起平坐。
examples.en: She was of humble birth, yet stood level with the high and mighty.

story.en: Chen Sheng, rousing the conscripts to revolt, cried: 'Are kings, marquises, generals and ministers born with their rank?' (王侯将相宁有种乎).
story.zh: 陈胜起义时说：“王侯将相宁有种乎！”

usage.en: A set phrase for the ruling elite, often with a hint of 'common people can rise too'. 将 is read jiàng ('general'), not jiāng.
usage.zh: 泛指统治阶层。“将”读jiàng，指将军。

natural: gathered water makes a deep pool

meaning.en: Small amounts, accumulated, become great; persistent effort pays off.
meaning.zh: 水积多了就成深潭，比喻积少成多，持之以恒会有大成。

equivalents: little by little makes a lot

examples.zh: 学习要积水成渊，不能急于求成。
examples.en: Study should build up gradually and you shouldn't be impatient.

examples.zh: 积水成渊，坚持每天练习就能进步。
examples.en: Drops gather into a pool; keep practising every day and you'll improve.

examples.zh: 他靠积水成渊的功夫，终于完成了这部巨著。
examples.en: With patient accumulation, he finally completed this great work.

story.en: Xunzi says: 'When water collects and forms a deep pool, dragons arise in it; when goodness collects and becomes virtue, divine wisdom comes of itself' (积水成渊，蛟龙生焉；积善成德，而神明自得).
story.zh: 《荀子·劝学》：“积土成山，风雨兴焉；积水成渊，蛟龙生焉；积善成德，而神明自得，圣心备焉。”

usage.en: Positive; stresses gradual accumulation. In the same family as 积少成多, 聚沙成塔 and 水滴石穿. Original: 积水成渊，蛟龙生焉.
usage.zh: 褒义，强调逐步积累。与“积少成多、聚沙成塔、水滴石穿”同类。

natural: husband and wife glare at each other

meaning.en: A couple falling out and turning against each other.
meaning.zh: 夫妻不和，互相怨恨，闹翻脸。

examples.zh: 为了遗产，他们夫妻反目，对簿公堂。
examples.en: Over the inheritance the couple fell out and ended up in court.

examples.zh: 多年的猜疑最终令夫妻反目。
examples.en: Years of suspicion finally set husband and wife against each other.

examples.zh: 别让金钱毁了感情，夫妻反目就不值得了。
examples.en: Don't let money ruin your marriage; it isn't worth falling out.

story.en: The Xiaoxu hexagram's third line says: 'The cart's spokes fall off; husband and wife turn their eyes away from each other' (舆说辐，夫妻反目).
story.zh: 《周易·小畜·九三》：“舆说辐，夫妻反目。”

usage.en: Negative; 反目 means 'to look away or glare angrily'. Often describes the end of a marriage over money or betrayal.
usage.zh: 贬义，“反目”指翻脸、互相怒视。多指因金钱、背叛而反目。

natural: spend one's best years in vain

meaning.en: To waste one's precious years with nothing to show for them.
meaning.zh: 白白浪费宝贵的时光，一事无成。

equivalents: waste the best years of one's life

examples.zh: 年轻时不努力，只会虚度年华。
examples.en: If you don't work hard when young, you only waste your years.

examples.zh: 他不愿虚度年华，决定重新学习。
examples.en: He didn't want to waste his years and decided to study again.

examples.zh: 退休后她不想虚度年华，开始学画画。
examples.en: After retirement she didn't want to idle her years away and started to learn painting.

usage.en: Often a warning or regret; usually with 不要、不能、不甘. 年华 means 'years, times of one's life'.
usage.zh: 常用作劝诫或悔恨，多与“不要、不能、不甘”连用。
